program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (bg (mode g -1))
                  (sep-rows (for/list ((r (range 0 hh)) #:when
                                (for/and ((c (range 0 ww))) (zero? (at g r c))))
                              r))
                  (sep-cols (for/list ((c (range 0 ww)) #:when
                                (for/and ((r (range 0 hh))) (zero? (at g r c))))
                              c))
                  (all-srows (append (list -1) sep-rows (list hh)))
                  (all-scols (append (list -1) sep-cols (list ww)))
                  (row-bounds (for/list ((i (range 0 (- (length all-srows) 1))) #:when
                                  (> (- (list-ref all-srows (+ i 1))
                                        (list-ref all-srows i))
                                     1))
                                (list (+ (list-ref all-srows i) 1)
                                      (- (list-ref all-srows (+ i 1)) 1))))
                  (col-bounds (for/list ((i (range 0 (- (length all-scols) 1))) #:when
                                  (> (- (list-ref all-scols (+ i 1))
                                        (list-ref all-scols i))
                                     1))
                                (list (+ (list-ref all-scols i) 1)
                                      (- (list-ref all-scols (+ i 1)) 1))))
                  (pattern-rb #f)
                  (pattern-cb #f)
                  (dummy (for* ((rb row-bounds) (cb col-bounds))
                               (unless
                                 pattern-rb
                                 (let ((r1 (first rb))
                                       (r2 (second rb))
                                       (c1 (first cb))
                                       (c2 (second cb)))
                                   (when
                                     (for/or ((r (range r1 (+ r2 1))))
                                             (for/or ((c (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
                                                     (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                                       (and (!= v bg) (!= v 0)))))
                                     (set! pattern-rb rb)
                                     (set! pattern-cb cb))))))
                  (pr1 (first pattern-rb))
                  (pr2 (second pattern-rb))
                  (pc1 (first pattern-cb))
                  (pc2 (second pattern-cb))
                  (ph (+ 1 (- pr2 pr1)))
                  (pw (+ 1 (- pc2 pc1)))
                  (pattern (for/list ((dr (range 0 ph)))
                             (for/list ((dc (range 0 pw))) (at g (+ pr1 dr) (+ pc1 dc)))))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (for* ((rb row-bounds) (cb col-bounds))
                   (let ((r1 (first rb))
                         (r2 (second rb))
                         (c1 (first cb))
                         (c2 (second cb)))
                     (when
                       (and
                         (not (and (= r1 pr1) (= c1 pc1)))
                         (for/or ((r (range r1 (+ r2 1))))
                                 (for/or ((c (range c1 (+ c2 1)))) (zero? (at g r c)))))
                       (for* ((dr (range 0 ph)) (dc (range 0 pw)))
                             (hash-set! result
                                        (list (+ r1 dr) (+ c1 dc))
                                        (list-ref (list-ref pattern dr) dc))))))
             (build-grid hh ww (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))
